consentDocument.documentHeading: Patient Consent for Collection and Use of Health Data
consentDocument.documentSubheading: Provided under the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 and applicable healthcare record-handling standards.
consentDocument.section1Body: Please verify the details on file. If anything is incorrect, ask the facility to update your record before signing.
consentDocument.section2Body: The facility named above collects, processes, and stores the following categories of personal and health data about you. Each entry lists the purpose for which the data is used.
consentDocument.section3Body: Your data is processed only for the following purposes:
consentDocument.section3Bullet1: Delivering clinical care, including diagnosis, treatment, and continuity across visits.
consentDocument.section3Bullet2: Communicating appointments, follow-ups, prescriptions, and lab results through channels you opt into (such as WhatsApp, SMS, or email).
consentDocument.section3Bullet3: Generating invoices, processing payments, and supporting insurance claims where applicable.
consentDocument.section3Bullet4: Maintaining mandatory clinical, billing, and audit records under Indian healthcare regulations.
consentDocument.section3Bullet5: Anonymous, aggregated quality and safety reporting. Identifiable data is never sold, leased, or used for marketing without your separate opt-in.
consentDocument.section4Body: Your data may be shared only with: (a) clinicians directly involved in your care, (b) labs and pharmacies you are referred to, (c) statutory or regulatory authorities when required by law, and (d) secure cloud and technology vendors bound by data-processing agreements consistent with the DPDP Act, 2023.
consentDocument.section5Body: Records are retained only for as long as necessary for clinical, legal, and regulatory purposes. Indicative retention periods:
consentDocument.section6Body: Under the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023, you have the right to:
consentDocument.section6Right1: Access a copy of the personal data we hold about you.
consentDocument.section6Right2: Request correction of inaccurate or out-of-date information.
consentDocument.section6Right3: Request deletion of data that is no longer required for care or legal reasons.
consentDocument.section6Right4: Withdraw any consent you have given (for example, WhatsApp communications).
consentDocument.section6Right5: Nominate a person to exercise these rights on your behalf in case of incapacity or death.
consentDocument.section6Footer: To exercise any of these rights, contact the facility using the details at the top of this form.
consentDocument.section7Body: I confirm that I have read and understood this form. I consent to the facility collecting, processing, and storing the categories of data listed above for the purposes described, in compliance with the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 and applicable healthcare record-handling standards.
consentDocument.consentRow1: Consent to general health data collection and storage (required for care)
consentDocument.consentRow2: Consent to WhatsApp reminders and follow-ups
consentDocument.consentRow3: Consent to email and SMS notifications
consentDocument.footerHeading: This form should be retained with the patient's medical record. A digital audit trail of the recorded consent is maintained by the facility.
consentDocument.footerBody: For questions about how your data is handled, contact the facility named above.
